entity.name: Attack on Titan
entity.description: Attack on Titan (original Japanese title: Shingeki no Kyojin) is a 2013 anime series adapted from Hajime Isayama's manga. Early seasons were directed by Tetsurō Araki and animated by WIT Studio, with later seasons produced by MAPPA under directors including Masashi Koizuka and Yuichiro Hayashi; series composition was handled by Yasuko Kobayashi and the score composed by Hiroyuki Sawano. The show blends dark fantasy, military action, and political drama as it follows humanity's struggle to survive behind massive walls against gigantic humanoid Titans. What begins as a revenge-driven survival story evolves into a sprawling, morally complex narrative about national history, ethnic persecution, war, and the ethical cost of freedom. The tone is bleak, intense, and often tragic, relying on visceral action sequences, large-scale conflict, and slow revelations that continually reframe who is victim and who is aggressor.

Directed for the anime adaptation by Haruo Sotozaki and based on the manga by Koyoharu Gotouge, the series combines intense supernatural combat, formalized 'breathing' sword techniques, and emotionally driven character arcs. Starring voice talent including Natsuki Hanae, Zach Aguilar, and Akari Kitô, it pairs breathtaking, painterly animation and dynamic choreography with themes of family, sacrifice, and compassion. The overall tone moves between heartbreaking intimacy and high-stakes, visceral action.

entity.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
entity.description: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners (2022) is a ten‑episode animated series produced by Studio Trigger in collaboration with CD Projekt Red and released on Netflix. Directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi, the series follows a poor street youth who turns to illegal mercenary work after acquiring military-grade cyberware, joining a ragtag crew of edgerunners in a neon-drenched, corporate-run megacity. Blending high-energy action and raw emotional drama, the show explores themes of body modification, class disparity, identity erosion, loyalty, and the personal cost of technological power. Its tone is visceral and tragic, pairing stylized, kinetic animation with a synth-tinged aesthetic to deliver a fast-paced coming-of-age story that ends in devastating consequence.

The series is notable for its cinematic, highly choreographed action sequences, richly realized world-building around curses and cursed energy, and themes of sacrifice, trauma, and morality. The emotional tone blends intense, often unsettling combat with heartfelt moments of growth and camaraderie.

entity.name: HOYO-MiX
entity.description: HOYO-MiX is the in-house music production studio of HoYoverse (formerly miHoYo). The team composes, arranges and produces original music for HoYoverse titles — most notably Genshin Impact — and has created soundtracks for Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero. Their work blends orchestral scoring, traditional Chinese instruments and folk motifs with electronic and ambient production; HOYO-MiX frequently collaborates with external orchestras, guest vocalists and international musicians and issues official soundtrack albums and digital releases tied to in-game events and character themes.

Yonezu is also an accomplished illustrator, often creating his own album artwork and visuals. His music often features introspective and poetic lyrics, and he has become one of Japan's most influential contemporary musicians.

entity.name: Tower of God
entity.description: Tower of God (2020) is an anime adaptation of the long-running South Korean webtoon by SIU. Produced for an international streaming audience, the series follows a young, sheltered protagonist who enters a titanic Tower to follow a friend and embarks on a perilous climb through floors filled with lethal tests, political intrigue, and supernatural forces (Shinsu). Stylistically an action-focused shounen fantasy, it blends fast-paced battles and strategic contests with serialized mysteries and character drama. Major creative contributors include webtoon author SIU and production by Telecom Animation Film in partnership with Crunchyroll; the adaptation emphasizes layered worldbuilding, shifting loyalties, and the emotional cost of ambition.

entity.name: Mob Psycho 100
entity.description: Mob Psycho 100 is an animated series based on the manga by ONE and produced by studio Bones, directed by Yuzuru Tachikawa, with music contributions credited to MOB CHOIR. The show follows a shy middle-schooler with growing psychic powers who tries to live a normal life while working odd jobs under an unlikely mentor and confronting supernatural threats. Blending action, comedy, and slice-of-life drama, it foregrounds character development, emotional themes like anxiety and belonging, and a deconstruction of shonen hero tropes. The series is praised for its striking, distinctive animation, kinetic action, and a mix of heartfelt and humorous storytelling.

entity.name: Dororo
entity.description: Dororo (2019) is an animated dark-fantasy series adapted from Osamu Tezuka's manga and produced by MAPPA and Tezuka Productions. Directed primarily by Kazuhiro Furuhashi and released in 2019, the show follows a young swordsman born missing most of his body after his father bargains with demons. Surviving with prosthetic limbs and no sight, he joins forces with a scrappy orphan thief to hunt the demons, reclaim his stolen body parts, and confront the human cost of the bargains that spawned the monsters. Combining brutal action, supernatural horror, and poignant character drama, the series explores identity, sacrifice, revenge, and the blurred line between human and monster, presented in a gritty, atmospheric visual style.

entity.name: Hell's Paradise
entity.description: Hell's Paradise: Jigokuraku (2023) is an anime adaptation of Yuji Kaku's manga produced for television, blending action, dark fantasy, and thriller elements. Starring Chiaki Kobayashi, Yumiri Hanamori, and Marisa Duran, the series follows a condemned shinobi and a squad of death-row prisoners sent to a legendary island to retrieve an Elixir of Life, only to become stranded and face monstrous supernatural threats. The narrative balances brutal, high-stakes combat with introspective character work, exploring themes of survival, redemption, and the quest for immortality. The overall tone is tense, haunting, and emotionally charged.

entity.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
entity.description: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (first aired 2012) is an animated adaptation of a long-running manga that follows successive members of the Joestar family as they confront supernatural threats across disparate eras. The series blends high-energy action, surreal visual flair, and genre-mixing tones that range from horror to broad comedy, with each story arc centering on a different protagonist. Themes of family legacy, identity, fate, and the cost of heroism recur throughout, while the distinctive visuals and inventive battle concepts create a memorable, often theatrical emotional experience.

entity.name: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
entity.description: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation (2022) is a Japanese animated television adaptation that blends action, adventure and dramatic fantasy. The series follows a thirty-four-year-old man who dies and is reborn as an infant in a new world, then grows into his second life while learning magic, combat, and social bonds. Notable cast members include Yumi Uchiyama, Tomokazu Sugita, and Ai Kayano; the show is distinguished by expansive worldbuilding, high-quality animation, and a focus on mature, morally challenging themes. Its narrative centers on trauma, redemption, and the complicated journey of personal growth.

entity.name: Darwin's Game
entity.description: Darwin's Game (2020) is an anime adaptation that blends action, mystery, horror, fantasy, and drama into a game-based survival story. The series follows a young man who becomes trapped in a deadly mobile app competition and must develop tactics, alliances, and resolve to survive. With intense, strategy-driven fights and a focus on moral choices and character growth, the show pairs high-energy animation and sound design to create constant suspense. Main vocal cast includes Yûsuke Kobayashi, Reina Ueda, and Nichika Ômori.

entity.name: Inuyashiki
entity.description: Inuyashiki (2017) is a Japanese animated TV series that blends science fiction, action, drama and horror. Featuring performances by Nijirô Murakami, Fumiyo Kohinata and Shin'ya Takahashi and adapted from Hiroya Oku's work by studio MAPPA, it follows an elderly man and a younger counterpart who are both rebuilt with alien technology—one using his powers to help people, the other to kill for sport. The show examines themes of morality, mortality, isolation and the responsibilities of power while delivering intense, emotionally fraught storytelling.

entity.description: Shadow and Bone (2021) is a Netflix fantasy drama adapted for television by Eric Heisserer from Leigh Bardugo's Grishaverse novels. Starring Jessie Mei Li as an orphan mapmaker who discovers a rare light-summoning power and Ben Barnes as a complex commander intent on harnessing it, the series weaves large-scale political conflict, supernatural threat and personal coming-of-age drama. The show brings together material from the Shadow and Bone trilogy and characters from the Six of Crows duology, mixing epic worldbuilding and military stakes with a tighter, character-driven heist subplot. Production leans on moody, cinematic visuals and a palette that alternates opulent court settings with the stark, frozen wastelands surrounding the supernatural Fold. Themes include power and responsibility, identity, persecution and found family; tonally it balances tense action, romance, and moral ambiguity.

entity.name: Great Pretender
entity.description: Great Pretender (2020) is an animated anime heist series that follows a gifted Japanese conman who becomes involved with an international crew of grifters and a rival con artist. Featuring voice work by Chiaki Kobayashi, Jun'ichi Suwabe, and Natsumi Fujiwara, the series blends crime, comedy, adventure, and drama across globe‑spanning scams. Its stories use clever misdirection and escalating cons to reveal characters’ traumatic pasts and shifting loyalties, exploring themes of deception, redemption, and moral ambiguity. The emotional tone mixes witty caper energy with genuinely moving character moments and stylish, jazz‑inflected visuals.

baseline.title: Pixel Pact: Anime × Play
baseline.concept: A cozy Austin watch party and game night for 30, with one group-selected episode, rotating game stations, and an anime-inspired playlist. All venue bookings, screening permissions, and sponsor partnerships would need confirmation.
run_of_show: 0:00–0:20 — Check in, grab snacks, and vote on the featured episode.
0:20–0:50 — Watch one episode with appropriate screening permission; flag spoilers and content warnings.
0:50–1:00 — Take a break and form six teams of five.
1:00–2:20 — Rotate through console party games, tabletop games, and anime trivia.
2:20–2:40 — Finish with a friendly team final, small prizes, and a group photo.
